summary: Researches H&M's catalog — storefront categories, product listings, product detail, free-text search, and nearby physical stores — using the Crawlora API, returning clean JSON. Use when the user asks to find a product on H&M, browse an H&M category, search H&M's catalog by keyword, pull an H&M product's colors/sizes/reviews, or find a nearby H&M store — instead of scraping hm.com.
